subject: Placement handler registry contract (S15): register_placement(kind, handler, requires_flag), naadi_api/ingest/placements/
body:
# Placement handler registry (S15) — `apps/api/naadi_api/ingest/placements/`

Consumers: S16 (`planner_items` for timetables/plans), S17 (`cost_entry` for fee receipts), S20 (`anki_deck` for .apkg). S15 ships `private_chapter`, `figure_overlay`, `notebook_page`, `flashcards`, `private_questions`, `kb_entry`.

```python
from naadi_api.ingest.placements import (
    register_placement, PlacementHandler, IngestView, Candidate, PlacementContext, PlacementRecord,
)

def register_placement(kind: str, handler: PlacementHandler, *, requires_flag: str | None = None) -> None
```
- `kind`: snake_case, unique (a second registration raises at import time). Registration lives in
  `naadi_api/ingest/placements/__init__.py` (one import line per module; you own your module, e.g.
  `placements/planner.py`, `placements/costs.py`, `placements/anki.py`; tell me on the ledger and add the line yourself).
- `requires_flag`: a `feature_flags` key; while it is off for the user the handler is never asked, never offered and
  `apply` is refused. Library's drop zone advertises an input type (e.g. Anki) only when a registered, enabled handler
  accepts it: `GET /api/library` returns `accepts: ["anki", ...]`.

```python
class PlacementHandler(Protocol):
    kind: str
    # Optional: input kinds this handler can take on its own (sniffed from bytes), e.g. {"anki"}. Used for `accepts`.
    inputs: frozenset[str] = frozenset()

    def propose(self, view: IngestView) -> list[Candidate]:
        """Pure: no DB, no network, no LLM. Return 0..n candidates (an empty list = not applicable)."""

    async def apply(self, ctx: PlacementContext, cand: Candidate) -> list[PlacementRecord]:
        """Write the placement inside `ctx.conn` (one transaction, service role). Every row is owned by
        `ctx.user_id`; every asset row references `ctx.source_id` (`user-provided`, or the URL's licence source).
        Return one PlacementRecord per row you created, so undo can delete exactly those."""

    async def undo(self, ctx: PlacementContext, records: list[PlacementRecord]) -> None:
        """Delete exactly what `records` lists (only rows owned by ctx.user_id). Must be idempotent."""
```

```python
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class IngestView:                       # what a handler may read; built after the sensitivity gate (never vault)
    item_id: uuid.UUID
    user_id: uuid.UUID
    input_kind: str                     # uploads.kind: pdf|docx|pptx|xlsx|csv|txt|md|html|epub|rtf|image|audio|video|link|anki|zip|paste
    understanding: Understanding        # {kind, title, taxonomy_ids, language, quality} from the one structured call
    doc: ExtractedDoc                   # sections [{heading, text, page_start, page_end}], figures [{key, page, width, height,
                                        #  caption, storage_path (owned webp)}], tables [{rows: list[list[str]]}],
                                        #  qa_pairs [(front, back)], mcqs [{stem, options[], answer, explanation?}],
                                        #  pages, word_count, media {duration_s, ...}, url, original_name
    flags: Mapping[str, bool]

Understanding.kind ∈ reading | lecture_notes | figure | handwritten_notes | flashcard_deck | question_set |
                     schedule | fee_receipt | article | other

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Candidate:
    kind: str                           # your registered kind
    score: float                        # 0..1; the highest is recommended (ties: registration order)
    preview: dict[str, Any]             # structured only, NO English: counts, titles from the document, target ids;
                                        # the web formats it with ui_copy key `ingest.placement.<kind>` (+ `.preview` keys you add)
    params: dict[str, Any]              # JSON-serialisable; handed back to apply() unchanged (checkpointed)

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlacementContext:
    conn: psycopg.AsyncConnection       # service role, inside the placing transaction
    user_id: uuid.UUID
    item_id: uuid.UUID
    source_id: str
    view: IngestView

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlacementRecord:                  # stored in ingest_items.placements (jsonb[]) for Undo
    table: str                          # e.g. "plan_items", "costs"
    id: str
    kind: str                           # your placement kind
```
Rules (review blockers): no LLM or network in propose/apply/undo (the pipeline's single structured call already ran);
nothing written before the student confirms (apply runs only after the confirm interrupt resumes); never write shared
rows (owner null) or anything `published` to other users; no answer of a question reaches a preview; previews carry no
name/email/ID numbers (the gate already ran, but don't copy raw receipt text into a preview — amounts/dates/labels only).
Batches: the pipeline groups candidates of every item in a `batch_id` into one confirm card
(`interrupt({"type":"confirm","action":"ingest_placement","batch_id",items:[{item_id, options:[{option_id, kind, preview, recommended}]}]})`).
Until S16/S17/S20 register, schedules/receipts/Anki decks are offered as `kb_entry` only.
